name: Ane Hame!
source:
Takuma is a uni student, lazing around at home every day since his parents are abroad and his older sister lives separate from him. One day, he faces the danger of flunk. To make matters worse, his parents know it, and decide to arrange him a home tutor, Reika. At first, he studies hard, but loses motivation soon. Instead, he has another desire... which is to insult her. He studies hard since then, and makes a promise with her. She says, "If you solve all the questions I give, I'll follow any order you make." He finally makes it, and asks for her body...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
拓马是一名大学生。父母去了国外，姐姐又与他分开居住，他每天都懒散地待在家中。一天，他面临留级危机。更糟的是，父母得知此事，为他安排了名叫丽香的家庭教师。起初拓马认真学习，却很快失去动力，转而产生另一个愿望…那就是羞辱丽香。自那以后，他又开始努力学习，并与她订下约定。丽香说：“如果你能解开我出的全部问题，我就听从你的任何命令。”拓马终于成功，向她索要了身体…
